about_the_game:
A lighthearted and enjoyable platformer game. In the game, players take on the role of a quirky Gulu Ball, embarking on a journey filled with jumping, exploration, puzzle-solving, and chasing to find their partner.

Story Background:

The story begins at the edge of Jumping Forest, where the blue Gulu Ball encounters the partner it wishes to pursue. Ahead lies the Jumping Forest—by passing through, it might catch up to the pink Gulu Ball and embark on adventures together. Collecting scattered fruits in the Jumping Forest may provide energy for the Gulu Ball, while gathering star-shaped energy can awaken dormant star gates, leading to the next adventure. Traversing the Jumping Forest might yield special items. Will new abilities be unlocked? What new adventures lie ahead?

The game currently features one map, Jumping Forest, with 30 levels and a rich design of mechanisms. The gameplay duration is 1 to 3 hours.

Additional maps such as the Desert of Death and Dark Hills are awaiting future development and exploration. New abilities? New adventures? Different experiences? Stay tuned.

Space - Jump

short_description: Play as a quirky Gulu Ball and embark on an adventurous journey to find your partner. Leap and bounce through a fresh, fantastical world, collecting scattered fruits and gathering energy to awaken dormant star gates. Special energy items may unlock new paths of exploration.
